verified_good_products.title: Wired Flat Type Net House
verified_good_products.description:
To sum up, you can also call them the Elite class. They are a little more sophisticated and are much better at producing high yield from a farm in wire rope net house. These houses provide absolute control of environmental factors and the outside environment has no effect on the growth of the plants in wire rope net house .

An innovative and modern agricultural greenhouse structure, specially crafted to cater agricultural farming need and designed to provide shade and protection to crops is referred as wire rope flat roof shaded net house or Wire Rope Net house structure. It constitutes of a flat roof which is supported by a framework made of wire ropes, with a shade net covering the structure to shield the crops from over exposure to excessive sunlight while allowing controlled air circulation and light penetration. This shade net house structure is robust and sturdy that could combat and withstand any natural adversities to its maximum capacity.

This type of structure is commonly referred by as a low-cost shade net house, wire rope flat-roofed shade net house, wire rope net house, low-cost greenhouse, shade net house for tomatoes, shade net house for capsicum, shade net house for cucumber, shade net house chillies, shade net house for cabbage cultivation, green shade net house, shade net house for fruit farming, shade net house for red capsicum, shade net house for yellow capsicum, shade net house for vegetable farming, shade net house for fruit farming, shade net house for banana farming, shade net house for pomegranate, shade net house for papaya, Shade Net House for Vegetable Farming (50% Shading), Shade Net House with Cable Support System or simply a shaded net house.

 

Technical Specifications ·         Frame Material

The framework of the wire rope shade net house is constructed using wire ropes made of durable materials such as galvanized steel or aluminum.

·         Optional Features

Additional features such as roll-up side walls, insect-proof screens, and irrigation systems can be integrated into the net house design based on specific requirements.

·         Netting Material

High-quality shade netting, typically made of nylon, is used to cover the frame, providing shade to crops while allowing ventilation and light transmission in this shade net house structure.

·         Roof Design

The roof of the net house is flat, providing uniform coverage over the crops and allowing for easy installation of irrigation and shade systems.

·         Dimensions

Wire rope flat roof shaded net houses come in various sizes, with widths and lengths customizable to fit specific agricultural needs and available space.

·         Anchoring

Secure anchoring systems, such as ground stakes or concrete footings, are used to anchor the wire rope structure firmly to the ground, ensuring stability, especially in windy conditions.

Frame material specified: GI pipe, wire rope, galvanized
Application or crop context: fruits farming, nursery, protected cultivation

extreme_good.title: Protected Cultivation Greenhouse For Fruits Farming (Wire Rope Flat Roof Shade Net House)
extreme_good.reason: Names application (fruits farming), cultivation method (protected cultivation), structural type (flat roof), and frame system (wire rope) — maximum buyer-relevant specificity.

extreme_good.title: 28x20m Green Shade Net House
extreme_good.reason: Includes exact dimensions (28x20m), colour (green), and product type — immediately actionable for a buyer comparing sizes.

extreme_good.title: Wire Rope Shade Nethouse
extreme_good.reason: Clearly identifies the wire rope structural variant and shade net type — two key purchase differentiators in one concise title.

acceptable.title: Flat Type Nethouse
acceptable.reason: Correctly identifies structural type (flat) and product category but omits frame material, shade percentage, and dimensions.

acceptable.title: Cable Purlin Nethouse
acceptable.reason: Names the cable purlin structural variant correctly but omits shade percentage, area, and frame material.

thin_titles.summary: Thin net house titles name the product type but omit structural variant, frame material, shade percentage, and dimensions.
thinness_signals: Title reads only 'Shade Net House' without structural type, frame material, or shade percentage
No dimensions, area, or size information included
No application or crop context provided

examples.title: Shade Net House
examples.reason: Title names only the product category — missing structural type (flat/dome/wire rope), frame material, shade percentage, and size.

irrelevant_titles.summary: Irrelevant titles name products that are not net houses — dragon fruit orchard structures and service/project listings contaminate this MCAT.

failure_classes.signal: Title names 'Orchard Structure' or 'Dragon Fruit Structure' — an open-field trellis system, not a net house enclosure.

examples.title: Dragon Fruit Orchard Structure
examples.reason: Names an open-field dragon fruit trellis/support system — fundamentally different product from a net house.

failure_classes.signal: Title contains 'Turnkey' or 'Customized Greenhouse Project' — indicates a construction service, not a physical net house product.

examples.title: Dome Shaped Poly-Net House (Turnkey/ Customized Greenhouse Project)
examples.reason: Framed as a turnkey/customized project service; specs confirm service-listing fields (Service Type, Service Mode, Duration).

wrong_mcat_classifier.description: Classifier to route listings that belong elsewhere — dragon fruit orchard trellis structures and service listings are the primary wrong-MCAT types found.

classes.signal: Title and description describe an open-field pole-and-crossarm trellis system for dragon fruit cultivation — no net house enclosure.

examples.title: Dragon Fruit Orchard Structure
examples.reason: Dragon fruit orchard structure is an open-field trellis/pole support system — not a prefabricated shade net house enclosure.

classes.signal: Specs use service-listing fields (Service Type, Service Mode, Service Location, Duration) indicating a construction/installation service rather than a physical product.

examples.title: Dome Shaped Poly-Net House (Turnkey/ Customized Greenhouse Project)
examples.reason: Specs classify this as a service listing with Duration, Service Mode, and Service Type fields — not a physical prefabricated net house.

input_sources_used.citation_note: All verdicts derived from enriched_products data and direct visual inspection of provided images.

No sibling MCAT matched the wrong-category products; correct_mcat_suggestion set to null for all invalid items as no taxonomy sibling covers dragon fruit orchard structures or greenhouse construction services.
